+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import collections.abc as cabc
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+
+from ._textwrap import TextWrapper
+
+
+class FirstLineExtraIndent(TextWrapper):
+    """A :class:`TextWrapper` whose :meth:`extra_indent` only indents the
+    first line of each wrapped paragraph.
+    """
+
+    @contextmanager
+    def extra_indent(self, indent: str) -> cabc.Iterator[None]:
+        old_initial_indent = self.initial_indent
+        old_subsequent_indent = self.subsequent_indent
+        self.initial_indent += indent
+
+        try:
+            yield
+        finally:
+            self.initial_indent = old_initial_indent
+            self.subsequent_indent = old_subsequent_indent

+++ b/tests/test_first_line_extra_indent.py
@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+import pytest
+
+from click.first_line_extra_indent import FirstLineExtraIndent
+
+
+def test_extra_indent_only_initial():
+    w = FirstLineExtraIndent(width=12, initial_indent="> ", subsequent_indent="| ")
+
+    with w.extra_indent("  "):
+        assert w.initial_indent == ">   "
+        assert w.subsequent_indent == "| "
+        assert w.fill("aaa bbb ccc ddd") == ">   aaa bbb\n| ccc ddd"
+
+    assert w.initial_indent == "> "
+    assert w.subsequent_indent == "| "
+
+
+def test_extra_indent_restores_on_error():
+    w = FirstLineExtraIndent(initial_indent="a", subsequent_indent="b")
+
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError), w.extra_indent("x"):
+        w.subsequent_indent = "changed"
+        raise ValueError
+
+    assert w.initial_indent == "a"
+    assert w.subsequent_indent == "b"
